main_sampler.description: Draft-and-review on GSM8K: MASK-ON reconstructed Fast dLLM v2 drafts with its native block decoder (greedy token selection, confidence threshold 0.8, 32-token blocks, eight-token sub-blocks); the unchanged Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct reviews the draft with greedy generation and a 1,024-token review budget
main_sampler.gen_length_printed: a maximum of 1,024 newly generated tokens

study.venue_line_text: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027

credited_component.text: MASK-ON: compression of AR-to-diffusion updates by closed-form scale fitting and pruning-level selection on endpoint activations

design.other_detail: D15 other: closed-form non-negative least squares matching the diffusion endpoint's linear-layer outputs on calibration activations, fitting output-channel scales of a ternary-mask AR-to-diffusion update, pruning level chosen by reconstruction error; no gradient training. D10 output-level: the unchanged AR checkpoint reviews and repairs the complete diffusion draft.
design.inherited_from: Fast dLLM v2 (D01, D02, D04-D06, D08, D11); confidence-aware parallel decoding, Wu et al., 2026b (D07)

census.F2_detail: Draft: Fast dLLM v2 native block decoder on MASK-ON weights, greedy token selection (highest-probability tokens), positions above confidence threshold 0.8 within eight-token sub-blocks of 32-token blocks, revealed tokens fixed; review: unchanged Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, greedy, 1,024-token budget. Variants: draft threshold 0.9; diffusion reviewer at threshold 1. Main tables: temperature 0, top-p 1, confidence threshold 1.
